entities.summary: Yaghma Golrouyi is an Iranian lyricist, poet, writer, and translator. Notable works by Golrouyi include "Khaste Shodam", "Royaei" (Dream), "Setareh" (Star), "Ziāfat" (Feast), and "Kuche Melli".
